props.exactPrompt: One isolated compact maintenance tool roll, partially rolled closed, for an inhabited orbital station trade counter. Heavy ochre waxed canvas with charcoal fabric pockets, a few short enclosed tool silhouettes under the cloth, two restrained dark webbing straps and small brushed-metal buckles. Clearly readable rolled textile shape, compressed folds, stitched hems, softened corners, seam grime and restrained oil-dark wear where hands and work surfaces touch. Practical manufactured everyday equipment, realistic human scale. Flat stable underside. No loose trailing straps, no scattered tools, no surrounding scene, no stand, no human, no lettering, logos or emissive parts. PBR game prop with clear cloth versus metal roughness; neutral unbaked lighting.

props.exactPrompt: One isolated neatly folded but well-used protective work jacket, laid flat as a compact retail sample. Petrol-blue heavy technical textile with restrained ivory reinforcement patches and matte charcoal trim, padded seams, double stitched hems, folded tucked-in sleeves, a short folded collar, compressed fabric layers and natural asymmetric creases. Practical orbital station security supplier equipment, believable cloth thickness and human scale. Subtle abrasion at raised folds, darker grime in seams, no exaggerated damage. Flat stable underside. No person, mannequin, hanger, armour shell, weapon, surrounding scene, lettering, logos or glowing parts. PBR game prop with soft cloth material response and neutral unbaked lighting.

exportBlocker.mechanism: Documented OpenAI Chrome playwright.waitForEvent(download) with the visible Download action prepared. The browser permission rejection interrupted the call and reset the browser REPL; the export settings remained open afterward.
exportBlocker.reviewReason: Browser security policy rejected the download. The tool reported: The user declined permission for this action.
exportBlocker.userActionRequired: Allow Meshy file downloads in the configured OpenAI browser integration before resuming exports of these existing sources. Do not submit new geometry jobs.

Search the exact prompt prefix for the desired prop. Both geometry batches show the date 09/06/2026 and x4.
The inspected default roll candidate shows Triangle, 22,431 faces, 11,245 vertices. The inspected default jacket candidate shows Triangle, 25,244 faces, 12,866 vertices.
The roll has a completed separate UV result; the jacket UV result failed and displayed Credits Refunded.
Resume only the remaining normal workflow on these existing sources after resolving the export permission blocker; no geometry rerolls were authorized.
